jobs.name: hero-weapons-vertical-v7
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game weapon sprite sheet for Ashen Axe. Create EXACTLY TWO isolated weapons in TWO columns by ONE row on 1024x1536 portrait canvas, each cell512x1536. Background entirely flat opaque uniform chroma green RGB(16,240,15), no gradients, texture, checkerboards, shadows or floor. Both weapons perfectly VERTICAL straight shafts, tip/head UP, grip at bottom, same bottom baseline, centered in own cell, whole object visible with generous margins. LEFT: one physically plausible symmetric double-bit battleaxe. A SINGLE steel axe HEAD at TOP of ONE straight wooden handle. Head consists TWO opposed broad crescent cutting blades joined by a compact central bronze socket around top of shaft; full wide flat face of blades seen perfectly SIDE ON, no perspective foreshortening. Head's long width goes horizontally LEFT-RIGHT perpendicular to vertical shaft. Left curved cutting edge faces LEFT and right curved cutting edge faces RIGHT. Symmetric conventional forged battleaxe construction, mechanically rigid. No blade at butt end, no horns, no twisting, no spikes, no extra heads, no extra extrusions. One long straight wooden handle descending from socket to simple leather grip near bottom. RIGHT: one straight steel longsword with pointed blade UP, simple bronze crossguard, dark leather grip below crossguard, simple bronze pommel at bottom. Entire flat blade face visible perfectly side-on. Natural realistic painted steel, wood and bronze materials, crisp hand-painted game sprite shading, shared neutral studio lighting. No characters, hands, labels, other objects or outlines of grid. One canonical view of each weapon designed to rotate as a rigid sprite. Strong clear physically correct axe head construction mandatory.
